messages.text:
I added another pass of common snippet commands and adjusted bare path handling so commands like `open sample.json` do not get mistaken for record field access.

I’m doing one more regression sweep plus a tiny filesystem round trip now.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, tempfile, os
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); exe=['python','executable']
cases=[\"10 / 5\",\"2.0\",\"[1 2 3] | math avg\",\"{a: 1} | to json --raw\",\"'x' | str capitalize\",\"'a b c' | str replace --all ' ' '-'\",\"[1 2] | is-empty\",\"[] | is-empty\",\"[[a b]; [1 2] [3 4]] | reject b\",\"let x = 4; "'$x + 1"]
for c in cases:
 r=subprocess.run([ref,'"'-c',c],capture_output=True); p=subprocess.run(exe+['-c',c],capture_output=True)
 ok=(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)==(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr)
 print(('OK ' if ok else 'DIFF ')+c.encode('ascii','backslashreplace').decode())
 if not ok: print('ref',r.returncode,repr(r.stdout[:200]),repr(r.stderr[:200])); print('py ',p.returncode,repr(p.stdout[:200]),repr(p.stderr[:200]))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='.') as d:
    pathlib.Path(d,'a.json').write_text('{\"x\":2}\\n',encoding='utf-8')
    os.chdir(d)
    for c in [\"open a.json | get x\", \"'hi' | save out.txt\", \"open out.txt\"]:
      r=subprocess.run([ref,'-c',c],capture_output=True); p=subprocess.run(['python', os.path.join('..','executable'),'-c',c],capture_output=True)
      print(('OK ' if (r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)==(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr) else 'DIFF ')+c)
      if r.stdout"'!=p.stdout or r.returncode!=p.returncode: print('"'ref',r.returncode,repr(r.stdout),repr(r.stderr)); print('py',p.returncode,repr(p.stdout),repr(p.stderr))
'@ | python -"
